subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Technology has become __a part and parcel__ of modern lifestyle.
solution:
The correct answer is: '**an integral part'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **'a part and parcel'** means something that is **intimately connected and fundamental** to something else. (किसी चीज़ का एक बुनियादी और ज़रूरी हिस्सा)
 
• Here, it implies that technology is not just an extra thing we have, it's become essential to how we do basically everything.
 
 
• **For example:** *Laughter and joy are **part and parcel** of a strong and healthy relationship*.
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it is clear that **'an integral part'** is the most appropriate meaning of "**a part and parcel".**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some idioms that convey a **similar** meaning to "**a part and parcel":**

 
 
• **Bread and butter:** Essential or basic components, often referring to one's livelihood or main source of income.
 
• **Hand in glove:** Working closely together, often in a harmonious or cooperative way.
 
• **Cut from the same cloth:** Similar in nature or character; having shared qualities.
